definitions.explanation: A neutral term for wife. This is the most straightforward word for referring to one's spouse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{妻|つま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{妻|つま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went shopping with my wife.

examples.japanese: {妻|つま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been ten years since I married my wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{妻|つま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}で→上手：00707_jouzu⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}っています→歌う：00684_utau⟧。⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しそう→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My wife is good at singing, and she sings at home every day. She seems to really enjoy it.

notes: {妻|つま} is a neutral, modern term for 'wife' and is commonly used in both spoken and written Japanese. It's often preferred over ⟦{家内|かない}→家内：00958_kanai⟧ by those who want to avoid the traditional connotations. The male equivalent is ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧. In official documents, {妻|つま} is the standard term. In casual conversation, many people also use ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧ or ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧.
